name: brand-headline
title: Brand Headline
description: A theme-linked opening statement with an editorial frame and a decisive brand lockup.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite the message, preserve the short three-line hierarchy, and reposition the lockup without changing the seekable opening timeline.

variables.label: Headline
variables.default: Build the work that moves people.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

events.action: Resolve the brand lockup and hold

useWhen: Open with one concise brand promise and one supporting statement.
avoidWhen: Do not use for evidence-heavy teaching, multiple claims or a fake logo/endorsement.

inputRules.kicker: Supply real kicker within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.headline: Supply real headline within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.supporting: Supply real supporting line within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

cueBindings.headline: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Establish the primary message. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.supporting: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal supporting meaning. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input; if unavailable use an honest custom treatment or report the missing content, not demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose a component whose narrative job fits, or author a finite seek-safe custom scene. Recipe reuse is a default, not a requirement to force-fit content.

example.narration: 晚上，也有一个能坐下来的地方。这是面向附近居民的公共学习空间。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Read the identity cue → Land one headline → Read supporting meaning → Settle on the mark. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
